description: Wire coupon validation to the backend, replace hardcoded static coupons record in veloura-store.tsx with live DB validation, and add live payment settings to the checkout page. Independent of FEAT-001 except it must run after FEAT-001 because api.ts hooks are extended there.
steps:
Step 2 — Update all call sites of `applyCoupon` that treat the return value synchronously.
  Files to check and update:
  - src/components/veloura/customer-confidence.tsx: `ShoppingConfidence` uses `onClick={() => { applyCoupon(code); setSelected(code); }}`. Change to: `onClick={() => { void applyCoupon(code).then(ok => { if (ok) setSelected(code); }); }}`.
  - src/components/veloura/customer-confidence.tsx: `CustomerExtras` uses `onClick={() => { applyCoupon('WELCOME10'); setApplied(true); }}`. Change to: `onClick={() => { void applyCoupon('WELCOME10').then(ok => { if (ok) setApplied(true); }); }}`.
  - src/components/veloura/commerce.tsx: `HomeDeals` uses `onClick={()=>{applyCoupon('WELCOME10');setSelected(true);}}`. Change to: `onClick={() => { void applyCoupon('WELCOME10').then(ok => { if (ok) setSelected(true); }); }}`.
  - src/components/veloura/shopping-ui.tsx: `CouponInput` uses `const valid=applyCoupon(code)`. Change to: `void applyCoupon(code).then(ok => setError(ok ? '' : 'Invalid or expired coupon.'));`.

Step 4 — Update the shipping calculation in src/lib/veloura-store.tsx to prefer live payment settings.
  - Import `useSettings` from '@/lib/api'. However, veloura-store.tsx is a React context provider, not a route component — hooks can be called inside `VelouraProvider`. Add `const { data: settingsData } = useSettings();` inside `VelouraProvider` function body.
  - Build live values: `const liveStdShipping = Number(settingsData?.payment?.delivery_charge) || storeConfig.standardShipping;` and `const liveFreeThreshold = Number(settingsData?.payment?.free_delivery_above) || storeConfig.freeShippingThreshold;`.
  - Replace the `shipping` calculation (currently `storeConfig.expressShipping` and `storeConfig.standardShipping` and `storeConfig.freeShippingThreshold`) with the live values. Express shipping falls back to `storeConfig.expressShipping` (no express field in PaymentSettings model).
  - Expose `liveStdShipping` and `liveFreeThreshold` in the context value as `standardShipping` and `freeShippingThreshold` so checkout and confidence components can consume them without calling `useSettings` twice.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with zero TypeScript errors
Entering a coupon code WELCOME10 in the cart calls POST /api/v1/coupons/validate when VITE_API_URL is set, and falls back to local coupons record when offline
CheckoutPage shows EasyPaisa/JazzCash/Bank options when those are enabled in the admin payment settings
Shipping amount in cart drawer and checkout reflects the DB free_delivery_above value when backend is running
verification: npm run build  (from project root — must succeed with zero errors)
With VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:8000: open the cart, enter WELCOME10 — network tab shows POST /api/v1/coupons/validate
findings: All 4 steps implemented. applyCoupon in veloura-store.tsx is now async (Promise<boolean>), calls api.validateCoupon when apiEnabled, falls back to local coupons record on network error or when offline. discountPercent state tracks the backend-computed or local percent for the discount calculation. useSettings() is called inside VelouraProvider to derive liveStdShipping and liveFreeThreshold; both are exposed in context as standardShipping and freeShippingThreshold. All call sites updated: customer-confidence.tsx (ShoppingConfidence offers + CustomerExtras popup button), commerce.tsx (HomeDeals WELCOME10 button), shopping-ui.tsx (CouponInput Apply button). CheckoutPage in commerce.tsx now calls useSettings() and builds paymentMethods dynamically from cod_enabled/easypaisa_enabled/jazzcash_enabled/bank_enabled flags, falling back to ['Cash on Delivery','Card — Demo','Online Payment — Demo'] when no methods configured or backend offline. payment_note is rendered beneath the payment selection when present. Build passes with zero errors. FEAT-003 can import standardShipping/freeShippingThreshold from useVelouraStore() context without calling useSettings again.
